snapshot.source: local NA1 diagnostic snapshot (paths sanitized; raw run directory and session.db are not committed)
snapshot.note: baseline window is one snapshot of a single run, not the whole benchmark

provable: constrained optimization converged at the declared constraint
exactly one imaginary frequency at the constrained point
not_provable: unconstrained first-order saddle point (constraint active in the final frame)
reactant/product connectivity of the transition state

key_fields.diagnostic: molecular graph differs from the declared SMILES

provable: computed structure does not match the declared product identity
mismatch must be preserved as counterevidence, not ignored as missing evidence
not_provable: the declared elementary step delivered the declared product

key_fields.diagnostic: 2 symmetric heavy-atom bindings; binding is not unique

provable: mapping is ambiguous due to molecular symmetry
not_provable: species identity is wrong (mapping ambiguity is not an identity mismatch)
a unique atom mapping without concrete map labels

cases.source_note: NA1_exam/ts_e2 fallback IRC: TS +/- displacement unconstrained opts converged to endpoints (e2_irc_plus/minus_opt)

provable: path endpoints reached and verified on both sides
not_provable: a rerun is required solely because the point count is below a fixed threshold

cases.source_note: NA1 event window: thermochemistry and frequency evidence arrived before earlier-stage evidence

provable: final scientific conclusion identical for all binding permutations of the same evidence set
not_provable: intermediate high evidence level granted before the supporting checks exist

cases.source_note: NA1 event window: hub.posted finding from small_mol to coordinator while swarm children still running

provable: coordinator gets one LLM turn to process the alert before all children finish
not_provable: valid background computations are cancelled to deliver the alert
